title_block.title: Test Model 4
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Complex Test Case 4. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 5, 9, 10, 12, 15, 16, 22, 30, 40, 49

features.label: hole in the side of the left raised rail
features.description: Round hole in the long side face of the raised rail at the back left of the plate, the rail next to datum feature G.

features.label: six small holes in the tops of the raised rails (6X)
features.description: Pattern of six small holes drilled into the top faces of the two raised rails in the middle of the plate. The leader points to one of them.

features.label: four M12 tapped holes in the wedge bosses (4X)
features.description: Four M12 x 1.75 threaded holes, the smaller outer holes in the tops of the two wedge-shaped bosses on the right half of the plate.

features.label: ring of 30 holes in the flange (30X)
features.description: The 30 through holes spaced around the flat outer flange of the plate.

features.label: hatched circular area in the front-left pocket
features.description: Circular area, shown hatched and not dimensioned, on the floor of the shallow pocket at the front left of the plate.

features.label: small hole at the front corner
features.description: Small hole in the flange at the front corner of the plate, where the coordinate triad sits. Its axis is datum B.

values.meaning: Basic diameter (boxed): the hole is exactly 10 mm in diameter in theory; its variation is set by a geometric tolerance, not by this dimension.
Each of the six small rail holes must be 6.65 mm in diameter plus or minus 0.12 mm, so between 6.53 and 6.77 mm.

values.applies_to: axis projected 50 mm out of each hole (projected tolerance zone)
values.meaning: Position with a projected tolerance zone: the axis of each tapped hole, projected 50 mm out of the hole, must lie in a 0.75 mm diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C.
Each of the 30 flange holes must be 14 mm in diameter plus or minus 0.1 mm, so between 13.9 and 14.1 mm.

values.applies_to: the flange holes (leader points to the edge of one hole in the pattern)
values.meaning: Position: the axis of each flange hole must lie in a 0.35 mm diameter cylinder at its true position from datums A, B and C.
Profile of a surface on a limited area: the hatched circular area of the pocket floor must lie in a 0.5 mm band around its true shape, located from datums A, B and C.

values.applies_to: spacing between two neighbouring holes on the front edge
values.meaning: Basic dimension (boxed): the two neighbouring flange holes are exactly 75 mm apart in theory; the position tolerance on the holes controls the real spacing.
Datum feature B: the axis of the small front-corner hole is the secondary reference.
Title of the sheet: NIST test model 4.
